correctness.rationale: PASS: Thaddeus §2.2 describes rank-u complete collineations as Vainsencher iterated smooth blowups of P Hom(S_V,W) over Gr_u(V). For each lower rank r, the transformed center records the u-plane, (u-r)-kernel and r-dimensional image, with square complete-collineation fiber C_r; smooth determinantal codimension is (u-r)(w-r). The smooth blowup changes χ by (codim-1)χ(center), giving square recurrence E_n=n²+Σ_{r<n}((n-r)²-1)binom(n,r)²E_r and rank-u recurrence binom(v,u)[uw+Σ_{r<u}((u-r)(w-r)-1)binom(u,r)binom(w,r)(r!)²]. With E_r=(r!)², both sums telescope through (j(j+q)-1)/(j!(q+j)!)=1/((j-1)!(q+j-1)!)-1/(j!(q+j)!), giving χ=binom(v,u)binom(w,u)(u!)² for all v,w and 1≤u≤min(v,w), including u=1 and square full-rank. Independently evaluated exact integer recurrences for (v,w,u)=(3,5,2),(4,4,4),(7,9,5),(10,12,7), checking 120,576,38102400,2414168064000. These finite tuples are only regression evidence; geometry plus telescoping establishes all dimensions.

value.rationale: PASS: The topological Euler characteristic of the canonical complete-collineation compactification is a natural all-rank invariant in algebraic geometry. An explicit uniform factorial closed form, including square wonderful compactifications and rectangular rank-u cases, identifies cell-count growth and a double symmetric-group factorial phenomenon. It is a useful invariant in studying blowup models, even without claiming a new full cohomology ring or Chow motive; nontrivial content is the uniform geometric center factorization and recurrence evaluation, not an arbitrary finite number.

limitations: Over complex numbers, 1≤u≤min(v,w), standard Vainsencher–Thaddeus rank-u compactification only.
Independent integer recurrence checks are finite; proof for arbitrary dimensions relies on locally trivial center geometry and exact telescoping.
